text_block_list.text:
The day of Маяно Топ Ган's final
showdown
with Нарита Брайан has
arrived—the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although she has grown into an even
better racer,
her dream of "twinkling"
has not changed...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Clutching that dream, she heads off to
race
Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
